privacy.rule: Never send personally identifiable information or free-form user input to analytics.

events.article_view: A full News or Insights article loads.
events.engaged_reader: The article remains visible for 30 active seconds.
events.source_click: The reader opens an external source from an article.
events.related_content_click: The reader follows an internal related-coverage link.
events.newsletter_intent: From publication-v2: a reader opens a subscription email request. Earlier versions also counted web-briefing navigation; do not compare as confirmed signups.
events.outbound_click: The reader opens another external destination.
events.cai_banner_impression: At least half of a labeled Cooperative AI Institute promotional banner becomes visible.
events.cai_banner_click: The reader clicks a labeled Cooperative AI Institute promotional banner.
events.cai_bn_imp_hdr_v1a: Header impression for current-training message A.
events.cai_bn_imp_hdr_v1b: Header impression for current-readiness message B.
events.cai_bn_imp_ctx_v1a: Contextual impression for current-training message A.
events.cai_bn_imp_ctx_v1b: Contextual impression for current-readiness message B.
events.cai_bn_click_hdr_v1a: Header click for current-training message A.
events.cai_bn_click_hdr_v1b: Header click for current-readiness message B.
events.cai_bn_click_ctx_v1a: Contextual click for current-training message A.
events.cai_bn_click_ctx_v1b: Contextual click for current-readiness message B.
events.briefing_open: A reader opens the web-briefing page; not an email signup.
events.newsletter_subscription_confirmed: Provider-confirmed opt-in only, deduplicated by the provider confirmation receipt. UNCONNECTED: no enrollment backend or confirmation callback exists; no browser event is emitted.
events.roi_view: One visible standalone calculator view per page load. Private implementation remains dry-run.
events.roi_start: One calculator workflow start per page load; denominator for completion rate.
events.roi_calculation_complete: One successful valid calculation per started page load; invalid inputs and repeated calculations do not add completions. No financial values are sent.
events.roi_feedback_click: One feedback entry opening per calculator page load; not delivery or resolution.

linkedin.utm_content: Use the immutable automation/social-queue.json item id.
linkedin.rule: Keep articleUrl canonical. Store the tagged URL separately as distributionUrl and use distributionUrl in the LinkedIn post copy.

cai.rule: Keep every CAI banner clearly labeled Sponsored, assign one stable message per browser, use only privacy-safe attribution fields, and report impressions and clicks separately from independent editorial performance.

growthWindows.rule: Use the 7-day view for current operations and the 28-day view for directional decisions. Do not treat pending or unavailable metrics as zero.

measurementBoundaries.calculatorStatus: private dry-run; hosted receipt and approved consent/tag activation pending
measurementBoundaries.confirmedSubscriptionStatus: unconnected; mailto request is neither enrollment nor delivery
measurementBoundaries.internalTests: Private publication events suppressed for loopback, webdriver, CUAIInternalTraffic or cuai_internal_traffic local marker. Existing GA admin internal/developer filter coverage must be verified independently. Never silently subtract undated historic test counts. On Alerts, PSECU, Plaid and Briefings, the shared tag bootstrap also skips automatic pageviews/tag loading off the production host or when internal/automated markers are present. This does not certify GA admin filters or alter legacy bootstrap on other routes.
measurementBoundaries.completionDenominator: Distinct per-page roi_start workflows; distinct per-page valid roi_calculation_complete numerator. Repeated calculations, users, sessions and page loads are different units.
measurementBoundaries.signupDenominator: Confirmed provider opt-ins divided by eligible subscription starts in a matched window only after both are connected; never newsletter_intent or briefing_open as confirmed opt-ins.
measurementBoundaries.crossPropertyJoin: Compare matched dates/timezone, source/medium/campaign/placement/variant. Generic clicks are not added to cell events. A click is not necessarily one destination session. Unknown destination or exclusion coverage remains null, never zero.
measurementBoundaries.reviewAfter: Seven complete days after an approved release, excluding internal tests; prepare baseline now, do not start the clock from this private build.
